paragraphs.source_en: Honda Sakuzaemon Shigetsugu, who had hurried from Hamamatsu Castle to hold Okazaki Castle during Nobuyasu's first campaign, was stopped by Ōga Yashirō before the armory. He turned around casually. He wore an unlined robe open at the front, exposing a chest drenched in sweat.

units.source_en: Honda Sakuzaemon Shigetsugu, who had hurried from Hamamatsu Castle to hold Okazaki Castle during Nobuyasu's first campaign, was stopped by Ōga Yashirō before the armory. He turned around casually.
units.source_zh: 从滨松城赶过来，负责在信康初征期间留守冈崎城的本多作左卫门重次，在兵器库前被大贺弥四郎叫住了，他漫不经心地转过头来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 从滨松城赶过来，负责在信康初征期间留守冈崎城的本多作左卫门重次，在兵器库前被大贺弥四郎叫住了，他漫不经心地转过头来。他穿着单衣，袒露出浸满汗水的胸膛。

paragraphs.source_en: “Sakuzaemon, have you heard the news of the young lord?” Yashirō chose his words with great care when speaking to Sakuzaemon. “He has ordered me to lead the provision train to the country between Asuke and Busetsu.”

paragraphs.source_en: Sakuzaemon's words engraved themselves deeply in Yashirō's mind. A smile crept to his lips, but he hastily suppressed it. It was none other than Yashirō who had incited Nobuyasu to pursue the enemy as far as Busetsu Castle. To think that “Demon Sakuza” would reveal every detail of Ieyasu's momentous plan to him while frowning in concern! Yashirō found it immensely amusing. At some point Sakuzaemon had closed his eyes, apparently lost in painful deliberation.

paragraphs.source_zh: 作左卫门的话深深刻在弥四郎心里，他嘴角不禁露出笑意，又赶紧抑制住了。煽动信康追击至武节城的不是别人，正是弥四郎。没想到鬼作左居然皱着眉头将家康的重大计划一五一十地透露给了他。弥四郎感到十分可笑。不知何时，作左卫门已经闭上眼睛，好像陷入了苦苦思索之中。

paragraphs.source_en: Yashirō tried hard to guess what was troubling Sakuzaemon. Would he pursue Nobuyasu to Busetsu Castle, or remain in Okazaki? No doubt he was troubled because the fighting was spreading across the broad region of Nagashino, Hamamatsu, and Okazaki, and he did not know which course to choose.

paragraphs.source_en: “By when, at the latest, must the young lord obey our lord's order to return to Hamamatsu Castle immediately?” Yashirō deliberately furrowed his brow as he asked.

paragraphs.source_en: Sakuzaemon showed no intention of answering at once. Beads of sweat as large as beans formed on his forehead. He kept his eyes gently closed, and only after a long while did he finally speak: “Pursue the young lord and tell him for me: he must not become engrossed in battle.”
